name: Spannerbay
summary: An eight-page car workshop admin with a live bay board you drag cars onto
about: Spannerbay runs a made-up car repair garage in Lahore: bays, job cards, bookings, customers and their cars, parts and invoices. The workshop floor shows each bay from above with the car on its lift and a progress ring that ticks as the mechanic works. Good for a car garage, a tyre shop or a vehicle service centre.
how: Drag a waiting car into a free bay, or use the arrow button to pick a bay
Watch the job progress ring fill; finished cars move to Ready for pickup
Open a job card to tick the checklist and add parts from stock
Take payment on an invoice by cash, card or bank transfer
Drag a booking to another day, or check a car in when it arrives
Clock a mechanic in or out and see their jobs pause
